purpose: Measure CT lossless BF16 KDA, the same CT with real native MXFP8 KDA, and ModelOpt under identical serving settings.
notes: Three loads per mode in balanced A/B/P, B/P/A, P/A/B order; two trials per case/load gives six trials per mode.
Identical DFlash 7/5/3 policy, graph sizes, prefix cache off, 10 ms idle admission, 8,192 context, 16 sequence slots, 2,048-token prefill budget and 6 GiB KV/rank.
C8/C16 describe offered concurrent requests. Retain running/waiting/KV metrics: six GiB may limit resident sequences, and this is not full production tuning.
CT modes differ only in KDA storage/arithmetic. Both retain compressed expert scales and vocabulary. ModelOpt uses its original model format without the new packing.
MXFP8 KDA rounding must match every hash in the completed quality run; native components require exact basis decoding and relative L2 <= 0.01 versus FP32 decoded-weight multiplication.
Original production restored on every exit. No checkpoint rewrite or automatic promotion.
The existing 1e-5 full-model KL gate failed in the rounding study and is not relaxed. GSM8K is unmeasured.
Keep all outputs, speculation acceptance and per-request timings. Different model outputs are permitted and disclosed; end-to-end gains cannot be attributed solely to kernels.
Same-mode repeat control is unchanged: (max-min)/mean across three load-median throughput values <= 2%. Failures remain visible.
Timing groups finish before separate C1/C8/C16 profiles in each final load. Record clocks/thermals/resources every three seconds and serving queue metrics every 0.5 seconds.
